title: TFRS: Incorporating Side Features and Deep Retrieval

cues.en: So as we said earlier, the real power of TFRS is its flexibility.
cues.zh: 如前所說，TFRS 真正的力量是彈性。

cues.en: You know, it doesn't really tie you into a black box for making recommendations.
cues.zh: 不會把推薦綁在黑盒子裡。

cues.en: It's just sort of a thin layer on top of keris where you can still put things together, however you see fit, really, and define whatever kind of a model you want.
cues.zh: 只是 Keras 上很薄的一層，你仍能依照想法組合，定義任何模型。

cues.en: So that means you can do things like implementing side features.
cues.zh: 因此，能實作輔助特徵。

cues.en: We talked earlier about the Querrey tower where we were just converting user IDs to integers and putting that into embedding layer, and that's all we did.
cues.zh: 前面查詢塔，只將使用者 ID 轉整數、送嵌入層，僅此而已。

cues.en: But you can do more complicated things in this quote unquote tower, for example, we could put in additional data besides just the user ID.
cues.zh: 但這座「塔」，可以做更複雜的事，例如加入 ID 以外資料。

cues.en: We could incorporate the time stamp that that rating was made.
cues.zh: 可以加入評分時間戳記。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So or anything else you can imagine or any sort of metadata about that user could be included in that query tower.
cues.zh: 或任何想到的資訊、使用者中繼資料，都能納入查詢塔。

cues.en: And to do that, all we have to do is add in that additional data as additional columns here on the right here.
cues.zh: 只要像右邊這樣，把額外資料加成額外欄。

cues.en: So in this example here, we have the original embedding layer that was just the user IDs, but then we have another embedding layer that's based on normalized timestamps.
cues.zh: 這個例子，有原本只含使用者 ID 的嵌入層，也有另一個根據正規化時間戳記的嵌入層。

cues.en: So maybe we can normalize when the query was made over some time range.
cues.zh: 例如，在某時間範圍，正規化查詢時間。

cues.en: If we think that, you know, ratings that are done in the past are of different relevance, then ratings that were made more currently, maybe our model could pick up on that.
cues.zh: 如果覺得舊評分與較近期評分，相關程度不同，也許模型能學到。

cues.en: Or maybe you could discreties, those timestamps and the buckets.
cues.zh: 或將時間戳記離散化、分桶。

cues.en: Maybe you could convert them into days of the week.
cues.zh: 也許轉成星期幾。

cues.en: For example, if you think that it being a weekend versus a weekday makes a difference, maybe that's something worth capturing.
cues.zh: 例如，若週末與平日有差，值得捕捉。

cues.en: Maybe the month is important.
cues.zh: 也許月份重要。

cues.en: You know maybe people behave differently around Christmas time, right.
cues.zh: 也許人們在聖誕節前後，行為不同，對吧？

cues.en: These are all things that you could capture and include in your query tower by just creating more and more embedding layers that capture that information.
cues.zh: 這些都能捕捉，只要建立更多嵌入層，加入查詢塔。

cues.en: And then you just concatenate them all together.
cues.zh: 再全部串接。

cues.en: And that makes up the new output of your query tower that gets fed into your larger retrieval model.
cues.zh: 構成查詢塔的新輸出，送入更大的檢索模型。

cues.en: Ok. Now there is some thought that has to go into this.
cues.zh: 好，這需要思考。

cues.en: You know, not all data is going to be helpful.
cues.zh: 不是所有資料都有幫助。

cues.en: Some could actually be harmful.
cues.zh: 有些甚至有害。

cues.en: So you do need to give some thought as to whether the information you're adding into your query tower is really adding additional context that is useful for making recommendations.
cues.zh: 必須想想，加入查詢塔的資訊，是否真的增加有助推薦的情境。

cues.en: Also pre-processing is up to you. Neural networks tend to like data in a specific format, so you need to make sure that your categorical data is embedded and not just used raw.
cues.zh: 前處理也由你負責。神經網路偏好特定格式，所以類別資料，要嵌入，別直接用原始值。

cues.en: You want to make sure that any continuous features are normalized. For things like timestamps, because that will play nicer when you're mixing that with other types of data.
cues.zh: 時間戳記等連續特徵，要正規化，與其他資料混合時，才比較好處理。

cues.en: You don't want to have one data type be overwhelming another one just because it's at a different scale.
cues.zh: 不希望某種資料，只因尺度不同，就壓過其他資料。

cues.en: You want to make sure that the data is standardized when appropriate.
cues.zh: 適當時，要標準化。

cues.en: So, you know, if you do have data where it makes sense to like normalize that into a bell curve of one standard deviation, that's a transformation you might want to do as well.
cues.zh: 因此，如果適合轉成一個標準差尺度的鐘形曲線，也可能想做這種轉換。

cues.en: And sometimes, like we said, dicratization, that's a hard thing to say, makes sense.
cues.zh: 有時，如前所說，離散化，這詞真難唸，是合理的。

cues.en: For example, maybe we want to discretize timestamps into days of the week, months, years whatever makes sense.
cues.zh: 例如，將時間戳記離散成星期、月份、年份，依合理情況。

cues.en: And if you're dealing with text data, of course, that needs to be vectorized into tokens for each word.
cues.zh: 文字資料，當然要轉成詞元，再向量化。

cues.en: Just feeding raw text into a neural network is not a good idea.
cues.zh: 直接把原始文字送進神經網路，不是好主意。

cues.en: But again, the idea is that if you have more information that might help the context of the recommendation, the context of the behavior that you're feeding into the recommender model. That might be beneficial
cues.zh: 概念是，如果更多資訊，能補充推薦情境、輸入模型的行為情境，可能有幫助，

cues.en: and it might help with the cold start problem by giving it that additional information.
cues.zh: 也可能協助冷啟動問題。

cues.en: And you can do this on the candidate model as well.
cues.zh: 候選模型，也能這樣。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So if you have additional information about movies, like maybe the actual text of the title is meaningful, maybe the genre is meaningful. You could add all that into the candidate tower in exactly the same
cues.zh: 如果電影還有其他資訊，例如片名文字有意義、類型有意義，都能用完全相同方式，加入候選

cues.en: way.
cues.zh: 塔。

cues.en: And again, that could help with the cold start case by giving your model more information to work with.
cues.zh: 同樣，讓模型有更多資訊，可能幫助冷啟動。

cues.en: By the way, there is an example of this on the tensorflow.org/reccomenders website if you want to dive into it, takes a while to run, so I'm not going to do it here.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，tensorflow.org/recommenders 有範例，想深入可以看。需要一段時間，所以這裡不跑。

cues.en: But if you do want to explore that in more depth, an example is available for you there.
cues.zh: 如果想深入探索，已有範例。

cues.en: Another thing you can do with TFRS what we call deep retrieval models.
cues.zh: TFRS 也能做所謂深度檢索模型。

cues.en: So we talked about a a multilayer preception on the ranking model side.
cues.zh: 前面談過，排序模型側使用多層感知器。

cues.en: But you can also do this on the retrieval model side as well.
cues.zh: 檢索模型側，也能這樣。

cues.en: And sometimes this is beneficial.
cues.zh: 有時有幫助。

cues.en: So let's take that query tower that we just talked about in the previous slide where we have embedding layers for user IDs and an embedded layer for timestamps. That have been preprocessed in some way.
cues.zh: 取前張投影片的查詢塔，有使用者 ID 嵌入層，以及經某種合理方式前處理的

cues.en: That makes sense, maybe even more information as well.
cues.zh: 時間戳記嵌入，甚至更多資訊。

cues.en: We can catenate all those embeddings together into a concatenated embedding layer and then we can take that even further.
cues.zh: 把所有嵌入串接成一層，再進一步。

cues.en: Maybe we feed that into a multilayer Perceptron after that, where we will put that into maybe a 64 wide neuron layer and then into a 32 Neron wide layer or whatever
cues.zh: 也許送入多層感知器，例如先 64 個神經元寬的一層，再 32 個，或任何

cues.en: makes sense.
cues.zh: 合理結構。

cues.en: You can experiment with those values and see where you get the best return.
cues.zh: 可以實驗數值，找出最佳回報。

cues.en: Again, we're kind of working from the top down here that's backwards from some diagrams that work from the bottom up.
cues.zh: 同樣，這裡從上往下看，與有些從下往上圖相反。

cues.en: But, you know, just make sure we're on the same page here.
cues.zh: 只是確認理解一致。

cues.en: But, yeah, you can make that retrieval tower stack as complex as you want and you just have to experiment to see whether or not that's beneficial.
cues.zh: 檢索塔堆疊，想多複雜都行，實驗看看是否有益。

cues.en: And again, you can do the same exact thing on the candidate tower side as well and feed that into a deep retrieval model if you wish.
cues.zh: 候選塔也能完全相同，想要的話，送入深度檢索模型。

cues.en: Sometimes that can be helpful.
cues.zh: 有時有效。

cues.en: There is, again, an example of this on the Tensorflow.org/recommenders website, if you want to see it in action.
cues.zh: 同樣，tensorflow.org/recommenders 有實作範例。
